Punjab rolls out Rs 10 lakh health insurance cards

The Punjab government has launched a health insurance scheme providing coverage of up to Rs 10 lakh. Residents can now obtain their health cards, which facilitate cashless treatment, without needing to visit government offices or deal with extensive paperwork. The cards can be downloaded from home using a mobile phone. This initiative aims to provide financial relief to those undergoing treatment.
